fullDescription:
Infuse dramatic elegance, high-fashion glamour, and romantic sophistication into your designs with Thayang! This striking display serif font features playful decorative curls, high-contrast letterforms, and grand sweeping underswashes that bridge words with effortless beauty. Its poetic curves and artistic ligatures turn simple headlines into captivating visual icons.

Ideal for high-end fashion logos, cosmetics branding, wedding invitations, luxury packaging, editorial magazine titles, romantic quote posters, and custom Cricut or Silhouette craft SVG designs!
